questions.question: Anta tewsatin n yiɣbula n isefka i zemreɣ ad qqneɣ?
questions.answer: Podacium BI yettdag aṭas n tewsatin n yiɣbula am CSV, Excel, JSON, d tbankiwin n isefka yettwasnen. Netteddu ad nrennu iqqanen imaynuten yal ass.

questions.question: Isefka-inu ḍemnen deg tɣellist?
questions.answer: Ih, s tidett. Nesseqdac aselket n tkebbaniyin (AES-256) deg weḥraz d usawaḍ. Akk isefka ttwaḥerzen deg wammasen n isefka iqadren asaḍuf s uselked n tɣellist amezzayan. Tesɛiḍ aḥkam d wayla amadud ɣef yisefka-inek.

questions.question: Esriɣ timussniwin titiknikiyin i useqdec n Podacium BI?
questions.answer: Uhu! Podacium BI yettwag i yimseqdacen itiknikiyen d wid ur nelli ara. Tabaɣurt-nneɣ s IA tessufuɣ-d tmuɣliwin d tsebntariyin s uwurman. Maca, imseqdacen uzwiren zemren ad sefrin tuttriwin d tesleḍt leqqayen.

questions.question: Amek tella tseddi n yisakan?
questions.answer: Inagrawen-nneɣ ttawḍen ɣer 73% n tseddi talemmast deg yal tamhelt n uskan. Taseddi tettnerni s wakud ticki anagraw yelmed seg tseddarin n isefka-inek. Nettak-d agemmay n tflest deg akk isakan.

questions.question: Zemreɣ ad ssifḍeɣ ineqqisen d tsebntariyin-inu?
questions.answer: Ih! Tzemreḍ ad tessifḍeḍ tisebntariyin deg PDF, PNG, neɣ HTML. Isefka zemren ad ttwasifḍen deg CSV, Excel, neɣ JSON. Netteddu ad nrennu tarrayin nniḍen n usifeḍ.

questions.question: D acu yellan deg uswir n baṭel?
questions.answer: Aswir n baṭel yesɛa armi d 2 n yigrawen n isefka, 4 n tsebntariyin, d tmahilin tigejdanin n tesleḍt. D ayen yelhan i yimdanen i la yebddun deg BI.

questions.question: Tezmer terbaɛt-iw ad teddukkel ɣef yiwet n tsebntart?
questions.answer: Ih. Isenfaren n tuddsa ttaken-d tamhelt n tdukli s yigrawen, tisebntariyin, d yineqqisen i yebḍan. Iɛeggalen zemren ad leddin tisebntariyin akken, ad rnun tizemmar, ad heyyin tisuraf, u ad rmesen iseɣtal m'ara d-yili usimer. Yal tuddsa tesɛa amḍiq-is yettwaḥerzen.

questions.question: Eski Podacium BI yettak-d API i unekcum s usnas?
questions.answer: Ih. Podacium BI yettak-d API REST i yessurufen asali n yigrawen, tuttriwin n isefka, asnulfu n yineqqisen, d usekcem n BI deg yisnisen-inek. Anekcum ɣer API yella deg yisenfaren n Tmerniwt (Growth) d wid yugaren, s warraten ikamalen.

questions.question: Acḥal n wakud i tteqqimen yisefka?
questions.answer: Akud n weḥraz yeṭṭafar aɣawas-inek. Isenfaren n baṭel ḥerrzen isefka i 90 n wussan, isenfaren n Tmerniwt i 1 n useggas, ma d isenfaren Scale d Elite fkan-d aḥraz war talast s tsertiyin n uḥraz yettwasefrayen. Tzemreḍ ad tessifḍeḍ isefka-inek melmi tebɣiḍ uqbel ad tfakk tallit.

questions.question: Zemreɣ ad ssewjedeɣ asnulfu awurman n yineqqisen?
questions.answer: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad tessewjedeḍ ineqqisen ad d-ttwasnulfun yal ass, yal imalas, neɣ yal aggur u ad tt-waznen s yimayl ɣer wid yerra wawal. Ineqqisen ttwasnen deg waṭas n tewsatin am PDF, CSV, d Excel. Tamahilt-agi tella deg yisenfaren n Tmerniwt d wid yugaren.
